title: Trace the European five-byte list direction bank
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI on Wine
changes: Traced the registered 0x98a-byte context and the full 128-slot list. Identified a six-row direction bank, five switch destinations and 30 Thumb literal words totaling 164 unowned bytes.
validation: Wine 18_slpld captured all 1,528 disassembly halfwords, kept 30 input guards intact and drained. Plan 1lt3a6fp corrects one expected instruction operand and passes with 18 guards using the retained Wine log.
limitations: Live owner and actor pointer identity, valid seed and cursor observations, ordinary and generated paths, original BIOS, native Windows, Linux and USA remain in the recovery checklist.
